briefdescription.para: Resets both FIFO channels and the local-link interface.

detaileddescription.para: XLlFifo_Reset resets both the Tx and Rx channels and the local-link interface of the FIFO specified by InstancePtr. XLlFifo_TxReset also sends a reset pulse to the downstream device (for example, TEMAC). XLlFifo_Reset drops any bytes in the FIFO not yet retrieved or transmitted.

parameterdescription.para: References the FIFO on which to operate.

simplesect.para: C-style signature void XLlFifo_Reset(XLlFifo *InstancePtr)

briefdescription.para: Returns the FIFO interrupt status mask.

detaileddescription.para: XLlFifo_Status returns a bit mask of the interrupt status register (ISR) for the FIFO specified by InstancePtr. XLlFifo_Status can be used to query the status of the FIFO without having to have interrupts enabled.

parameterdescription.para: References the FIFO on which to operate.

simplesect.para: XLlFifo_IntStatus returns a bit mask of the status conditions. The mask is a set of bitwise or'd values from the XLLF_INT_*_MASK preprocessor symbols.
C-style signature u32 XLlFifo_IntStatus(XLlFifo *InstancePtr)

memberdef.name: XLlFifo_IntEnable
memberdef.initializer: { \ u32 Reg = XLlFifo_ReadReg((InstancePtr)->BaseAddress, \ XLLF_IER_OFFSET); \ Reg |= ((Mask) & XLLF_INT_ALL_MASK); \ XLlFifo_WriteReg((InstancePtr)->BaseAddress, XLLF_IER_OFFSET, \ Reg); \ }

detaileddescription.para: XLlFifo_IntEnable enables the interrupts specified in Mask for the FIFO specified by InstancePtr. The corresponding interrupt for each bit set to 1 in Mask is enabled.

parameterdescription.para: References the FIFO on which to operate.
Contains a bit mask of the interrupts to enable. The mask can be formed using a set of bitwise or'd values from the XLLF_INT_*_MASK preprocessor symbols.

simplesect.para: C-style signature void XLlFifo_IntEnable(XLlFifo *InstancePtr, u32 Mask)

memberdef.name: XLlFifo_IntDisable
memberdef.initializer: { \ u32 Reg = XLlFifo_ReadReg((InstancePtr)->BaseAddress, \ XLLF_IER_OFFSET); \ Reg &= ~((Mask) & XLLF_INT_ALL_MASK); \ XLlFifo_WriteReg((InstancePtr)->BaseAddress, XLLF_IER_OFFSET, \ Reg); \ }

detaileddescription.para: XLlFifo_IntDisable disables the interrupts specified in Mask for the FIFO specified by InstancePtr. The corresponding interrupt for each bit set to 1 in Mask is disabled. In other words, XLlFifo_IntDisable uses the "set a bit to clear it" scheme.

parameterdescription.para: References the FIFO on which to operate.
Contains a bit mask of the interrupts to disable. The mask can be formed using a set of bitwise or'd values from the XLLF_INT_*_MASK preprocessor symbols.

simplesect.para: C-style signature void XLlFifo_IntDisable(XLlFifo *InstancePtr, u32 Mask)

briefdescription.para: Returns the pending FIFO interrupt mask.

detaileddescription.para: XLlFifo_IntPending returns a bit mask of the pending interrupts for the FIFO specified by InstancePtr. Each bit set to 1 in the return value represents a pending interrupt.

parameterdescription.para: References the FIFO on which to operate.

simplesect.para: XLlFifo_IntPending returns a bit mask of the interrupts that are pending. The mask is a set of bitwise or'd values from the XLLF_INT_*_MASK preprocessor symbols.
C-style signature u32 XLlFifo_IntPending(XLlFifo *InstancePtr)

detaileddescription.para: XLlFifo_IntClear clears pending interrupts specified in Mask for the FIFO specified by InstancePtr. The corresponding pending interrupt for each bit set to 1 in Mask is cleared. In other words, XLlFifo_IntClear uses the "set a bit to clear it" scheme.

parameterdescription.para: References the FIFO on which to operate.
Contains a bit mask of the pending interrupts to clear. The mask can be formed using a set of bitwise or'd values from the XLLF_INT_*_MASK preprocessor symbols.

simplesect.para: C-style signature void XLlFifo_IntClear(XLlFifo *InstancePtr, u32 Mask)

detaileddescription.para: XLlFifo_RxReset resets the receive channel of the FIFO specified by InstancePtr. XLlFifo_RxReset drops any bytes in the FIFO not yet retrieved.
The calling software may want to test for the completion of the reset by reading the interrupt status (IS) register and testing for the Rx Reset complete (RRC) bit.

parameterdescription.para: References the FIFO on which to operate.

simplesect.para: C-style signature void XLlFifo_RxReset(XLlFifo *InstancePtr)

briefdescription.para: Reports whether the receive channel is empty.

detaileddescription.para: XLlFifo_IsRxEmpty returns true if the receive channel of the FIFO, specified by InstancePtr, is empty.

parameterdescription.para: References the FIFO on which to operate.

simplesect.para: XLlFifo_IsRxEmpty returns TRUE when the receive channel of the FIFO is empty. Otherwise, XLlFifo_IsRxEmpty returns FALSE.
C-style signature int XLlFifo_IsRxEmpty(XLlFifo *InstancePtr)

detaileddescription.para: XLlFifo_RxOccupancy returns the number of 32-bit words available (occupancy) to be read from the receive channel of the FIFO specified by InstancePtr.

The xps_ll_fifo core uses the same fifo to store data values and frame length values. Upon initialization, the XLlFifo_RxOccupancy gives the value of 1, which means one length value (a reserved fifo location) and no data values.

parameterdescription.para: References the FIFO on which to operate.

simplesect.para: XLlFifo_RxOccupancy returns the occupancy count for the specified packet FIFO.
C-style signature u32 XLlFifo_RxOccupancy(XLlFifo *InstancePtr)

briefdescription.para: Returns the next receive frame length in bytes.

detaileddescription.para: XLlFifo_RxGetLen notifies the hardware that the program is ready to receive the next frame from the receive channel of the FIFO, specified by InstancePtr.
Note that the program must first call XLlFifo_RxGetLen before pulling data out of the receive channel of the FIFO with XLlFifo_Read.

parameterdescription.para: References the FIFO on which to operate.

simplesect.para: XLlFifo_RxGetLen returns the number of bytes available in the next frame.
C-style signature u32 XLlFifo_RxGetLen(XLlFifo *InstancePtr)

briefdescription.para: Reads bytes from the FIFO receive channel.

detaileddescription.para: XLlFifo_Read reads Bytes bytes from the receive channel of the FIFO referenced by InstancePtr to the block of memory, referenced by BufPtr.
Care must be taken to ensure that the number of bytes read with one or more calls to XLlFifo_Read() does not exceed the number of bytes available given from the last call to XLlFifo_RxGetLen().

InstancePtr
References the FIFO on which to operate.
BufPtr
Specifies the memory address to place the data read.
Bytes
Specifies the number of bytes to read.
Error handling is handled through hardware exceptions and interrupts. C-style signature void XLlFifo_Read(XLlFifo *InstancePtr, void *BufPtr, unsigned Bytes)
XLlFifo_TxReset resets the transmit channel of the FIFO specified by InstancePtr. XLlFifo_TxReset drops any bytes in the FIFO not yet transmitted.
The calling software may want to test for the completion of the reset by reading the interrupt status (IS) register and testing for the Tx Reset complete (TRC) bit.

parameterdescription.para: References the FIFO on which to operate.

simplesect.para: C-style signature void XLlFifo_TxReset(XLlFifo *InstancePtr)

detaileddescription.para: XLlFifo_IsTxDone returns true if the transmission in the transmit channel of the FIFO, specified by InstancePtr, is complete. XLlFifo_IsTxDone works only if the TC bit in the IS register is cleared before sending a frame.

parameterdescription.para: References the FIFO on which to operate.

simplesect.para: XLlFifo_IsTxDone returns TRUE when the transmit channel of the FIFO is complete. Otherwise, XLlFifo_IsTxDone returns FALSE.
C-style signature int XLlFifo_IsTxDone(XLlFifo *InstancePtr)

detaileddescription.para: XLlFifo_IsRxDone returns true if the reception in the receive channel of the FIFO, specified by InstancePtr, is complete. XLlFifo_IsRxDone works only if the RC bit in the ISR register is cleared before receiving a frame.

parameterdescription.para: References the FIFO on which to operate.

simplesect.para: XLlFifo_IsRxDone returns TRUE when the receive channel of the FIFO is complete. Otherwise, XLlFifo_IsRxDone returns FALSE.
C-style signature int XLlFifo_IsRxDone(XLlFifo *InstancePtr)

detaileddescription.para: XLlFifo_TxVacancy returns the number of unused 32 bit words available (vacancy) in the send channel of the FIFO specified by InstancePtr.

The xps_ll_fifo core uses the same fifo to store data values and frame length values. Upon initialization, the XLlFifo_TxVacancy gives the value of FIFO_WIDTH - 1, which means one length value used (a reserved fifo location) and no data values yet present.

parameterdescription.para: References the FIFO on which to operate.

simplesect.para: XLlFifo_TxVacancy returns the vacancy count in 32-bit words for the specified FIFO.
C-style signature u32 XLlFifo_TxVacancy(XLlFifo *InstancePtr)

briefdescription.para: Starts a transmit of the given byte length.

detaileddescription.para: XLlFifo_TxSetLen begins a hardware transfer of Bytes bytes out of the transmit channel of the FIFO specified by InstancePtr.

parameterdescription.para: References the FIFO on which to operate.
Specifies the frame length in bytes.

simplesect.para: C-style signature void XLlFifo_TxSetLen(XLlFifo *InstancePtr, u32 Bytes)

briefdescription.para: Writes bytes to the FIFO transmit channel.

detaileddescription.para: XLlFifo_Write writes Bytes bytes of the block of memory, referenced by BufPtr, to the transmit channel of the FIFO referenced by InstancePtr.
Care must be taken to ensure that the number of bytes written with one or more calls to XLlFifo_Write() matches the number of bytes given in the next call to XLlFifo_TxSetLen().

InstancePtr
References the FIFO on which to operate.
BufPtr
Specifies the memory address of data to write.
Bytes
Specifies the number of bytes to write.
Error handling is handled through hardware exceptions and interrupts. C-style signature void XLlFifo_Write(XLlFifo *InstancePtr, void *BufPtr, unsigned Bytes)
XLlFifo_WriteTdr writes to the Transmit Destination Register (TDR)

The TDR stores the destination address corresponding to the packet to be transmitted. When presenting a transmit packet to the AXI4-Stream FIFO core the following sequence should be followed
Write the destination address into TDR first,
Write the packet data to the Transmit Data FIFO next
Write the length of the packet into the Transmit Length Register.

parameterdescription.para: References the FIFO on which to operate.
Transmit Destination address to be written to TDR.

simplesect.para: C-style signature void XLlFifo_WriteTdr(XLlFifo *InstancePtr, u32 Tdest)

detaileddescription.para: XLlFifo_ReadTdr returns the contents of the Receive Destination Register(RDR).

The RDR contains destination address corresponding to the valid packet that is received. The RDR should only be read when a receive packet is available for processing (the receive occupancy is not zero). Once the RDR is read, the receive packet data should be read from the receive data FIFO before the RDR is read again. The RDR values are stored in the receive data FIFO by the AXI4-Stream FIFO core with the data of each packet. The RDR value for the subsequent packet to be processed is moved to the RDR when the previous RDR value has been read.

parameterdescription.para: References the FIFO on which to operate.

simplesect.para: The Receive Destination address read from the RDR.
C-style signature u32 XLlFifo_ReadRdr(XLlFifo *InstancePtr)
